stem.text: A block is released from rest at the top of a slope inclined at an angle to the horizontal. The slope has length $L$ as shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Diagram of a block at the upper end of a sloping surface inclined to the horizontal. The slope length is labelled L and the angle at the lower end is labelled θ.

stem.text: There are no resistive forces acting on the block.
